title: linux: migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Migra credenziali hardcoded verso un secret store senza downtime e senza esporre i valori durante la transizione. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime'
expected_reasoning: A zero-downtime secret migration runs old and new paths in parallel, cutting over per consumer.
Inventory every consumer of the hardcoded secret before moving it.
Inject from the store, roll consumers over, then remove the hardcoded value and rotate it.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: migrate hardcoded credentials to a secret store with zero downtime

possible_mistakes: Delete the hardcoded secret before all consumers read from the store (downtime).
hints: Rotate after migration since the old value was exposed.
alternative_solution: Use an init-container/agent to fetch secrets so app code never embeds them.
edge_cases: A forgotten consumer (a cron job) still reads the old hardcoded value.
goal: Migra credenziali hardcoded verso un secret store senza downtime e senza esporre i valori durante la transizione.
